Dubai-Based Director Faisal Hashmi Launches Spine Drop Pictures with Horror Slate

Dubai-based independent writer and director Faisal Hashmi has officially launched Spine Drop Pictures, a new genre-focused production company. Alongside the launch, Hashmi unveiled an inaugural slate consisting of three horror features designed to target the low-budget, high-concept market.

Background and Strategy

Hashmi brings a 15-year background in directing and writing contained genre shorts to the new venture. His previous short films, including *Amber*, *Wicken*, and *Skipped*, have screened at various film festivals and accumulated millions of views online. Additionally, he co-wrote *City of Life Continuum*, a sequel to the 2009 film *City of Life* directed by Ali F. Mostafa, and is attached to write and direct the upcoming English-language time-loop horror-thriller *Fractal*.

According to reported details, Spine Drop Pictures aims to produce commercially oriented genre films budgeted under $1 million. The strategy focuses on leveraging Hashmi's background in contained storytelling to maximize resource efficiency without compromising narrative strength.

Inaugural Horror Slate

The newly announced slate includes three projects written and intended for direction by Hashmi:

  • Off Plan: Described as an interconnected horror anthology comprising six stories set in Dubai during a single night. The production utilizes a modular shooting schedule to film segments independently using shared crew resources.
  • Cinder: A gritty supernatural thriller set in the remote mountain landscapes of the UAE, expanding upon Hashmi's 2020 award-winning short film *Amber*.
  • Latching: A feminist possession-revenge horror feature set in Karachi, Pakistan, unfolding over a single night.

Next Steps and Industry Outlook

Reported plans indicate that Spine Drop Pictures is currently exploring strategic financing, international co-productions, slate investment, and distribution partnerships. Hashmi emphasized the importance of financial sustainability and commercial viability within emerging independent markets like the UAE.

Readers interested in verifying these developments can review original trade reporting from entertainment industry publications such as Deadline or consult official company announcements released by Spine Drop Pictures.
